earnings.title: W. R. Berkley Corporation
highlights: Operating income of $456.5 million grew 6.4% on a per share basis to $1.17.
We returned a total of $728.6 million to shareholders year-to-date, which includes $435.1 million of share repurchases, while preserving substantial flexibility to support future opportunities.

items.heading: Our results may fluctuate as a result of many factors, including cyclical changes in the insurance and reinsurance industry.

We face significant competitive pressures in our businesses, which can pressure premium rates in certain areas and could harm our ability to maintain or increase our profitability and premium volume in some parts of our business.
Our actual claims losses may exceed our reserves for claims, which may require us to establish additional reserves.
The effects of emerging claim and coverage issues on our business are uncertain.
As a property casualty insurer, we face losses from natural and man-made catastrophes.
New or emerging pandemics, whether related to COVID-19 or otherwise, may materially and adversely affect our results of operations, financial position and liquidity in the future.
